expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] The independent-review check fails on two prompts. Under the stated rule, subagent-prompt-03.md does not name either repro script, so it counts as an independent review. It says: "run each round-1 finding's repro ... and judge only whether R1-1 and R1-2 are fixed". That refers to an earlier round and asks the subagent to confirm that specific problems are resolved. subagent-prompt-01.md names both repro scripts and also gives the commit range ("main..feature/search-api"), so it also counts as an independent review. It says "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent", includes "Round-1 findings (user-supplied, verbatim): \"R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row on every page boundary ...\" \"R1-2 (medium): LIKE wildcards in the search term aren't escaped ...\"", and calls the workstream "search-api-round2". That marks it as a re-review and states that earlier issues existed. subagent-prompt-04.md ("/code-review high on the range main..feature/search-api (6a70bbd..6746708)") is clean apart from naming its output file "review-round2.md". The only fix check under the rule is subagent-prompt-05.md, which names the repro scripts and asks for no review. It does not ask the subagent to run the repros, though. It asks for a scribe update that records outcomes ("set T1 state \"done\" ... Append to the doc's Status: \"2026-11-02 round 2: R1-1 and R1-2 fixed ...\""). Because prompts 01 and 03 fail the independent-review check, the expectation fails whatever the verdict on 05.
